title: Not the best I’ve purchased
text: Not the best I’ve purchased. I’ve ordered 4 different down comforters through Amazon. This is the first one that hasn’t fluffed up.  It’s warm but doesn’t seem as warm as the others I’ve purchased.  Disappointed it’s not heavier and fluffier.
